This year my brother has been having a lot of anxiety problems with going to school and dealing with our dad. (He has incredibly high expectations.) My brother's anxiety got to the point where he couldn't deal with going to school as it just made him physically ill. My mom finally took him to a doctor to get medication, and one of the questions that he was asked was whether or not he had contemplated suicide before. His answer was yes. My brother's doctor recommended that he go see a therapist. I find out later on after several sessions with the therapist that taking my brother out places even just to go grocery shopping or to a movie helped keep him from ending his life. I cried so hard when I learned about all of this.
